manipal-text2sql-agent.title: Analyst: Local Text-to-SQL Agent
manipal-text2sql-agent.tagline: The text-to-SQL agent that shows its work, and knows when to say no.
manipal-text2sql-agent.body: 100% offline, open-weight (≤8B) agent for messy real-world databases. Understand → Generate → Verify pipeline with candidate voting, calibrated confidence and refusals.
bullets: 🛡️ **0 / 57** RBAC data-leak attacks succeed (down from 75% raw)
🧪 117 offline tests · multi-turn & ambiguity eval sets

peach-ice-tea.title: Peach Ice Tea: Coding-Agent Harness
peach-ice-tea.tagline: One frozen prompt, one unattended run, evidence judges can verify.
peach-ice-tea.body: A Rust harness that makes autonomous coding agents trustworthy: test-integrity guard, runtime verify gate, staged context compaction, model failover, doom-loop escalation and evidence bundles.

tulasetu.title: Taraazu: OIML R-76 Report Engine
tulasetu.tagline: Smart India Hackathon 2026 · Dept. of Consumer Affairs (SIH26035)
tulasetu.body: Deterministic engine that computes legal type-evaluation reports for weighing instruments. The 62-page form is just a rendering. Golden-tested against the standards' own worked examples.

navher.title: NavHer: Women's Safety & Hygiene
navher.tagline: 🏆 National Hackathon Winner · Best Social Impact & User-Focused Solution
navher.body: SOS requests for emergency pads from nearby people, nearest hospitals & cleanest washrooms with live community updates, and cycle tracking.

reloop-main-app.title: ReLoop: Gamified Circular Economy
reloop-main-app.body: AI item recognition, a ReCoins economy and QR recycling drop-offs, plus a [worker app](https://github.com/Ankush-Jha/reloop-worker-app).

ai-interview.title: Viva: AI Interview Coach
ai-interview.tagline: Upload your notes, get grilled by an AI interviewer.
ai-interview.body: Socratic / Examiner / Friendly personas, adaptive difficulty, voice I/O and a neobrutalist UI.

hackathon-newton.title: Newton School for VS Code
hackathon-newton.body: VS Code extension with a zero-config **MCP server**. Ask Copilot about your courses, assignments and schedule.

ai-constellation.title: AI Constellation
ai-constellation.tagline: Agents that check each other's work.
ai-constellation.body: Drop-in Claude Code multi-agent setup where every agent's output is reviewed by other agents before it reaches you.
